title: inbuf_append: capacity-clamping branch is dead code
description: In inbuf_append, after the geometric doubling: 'if (new_cap > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN) new_cap = CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN;'. This branch is unreachable: the function returns -EMSGSIZE at the top if new_len > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN. Since new_cap = max(inbuf_cap*2, new_len), and new_len <= CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN (enforced above), the only way new_cap could exceed the limit is if inbuf_cap*2 > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN with inbuf_cap being CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN itself, which cannot happen since new_len > inbuf_cap when we enter the branch. Remove the dead clamp, or restructure to make the invariant explicit with a BUILD_BUG_ON or comment. Suggested rewrite: remove the dead clamp line entirely; the -EMSGSIZE guard at the top is the single source of truth.
close_reason: Analysis error: the clamp 'if (new_cap > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN) new_cap = MAXLEN' IS reachable. When inbuf_cap=5000 and new_len=5001, new_cap doubles to 10000 which exceeds MAXLEN=8192 while new_len passes the -EMSGSIZE guard. Code is correct.
